change.title: stripe-node v23: webhooks.signature.verifyHeader/verifyHeaderAsync now apply default timestamp tolerance; constructEvent tolerance 0 skips verification

source.quote: Passing 0 to stripe.webhooks.constructEvent now properly skips timestamp tolerance verification.

callSites.notes: Verifies stripe-signature via constructWebhookEvent (lib/billing/stripe.ts:252); idempotency via stripeEvent table. Handles checkout.session.completed, customer.subscription.created/updated/deleted, invoice.paid, invoice.payment_failed.

task.notes: This only applies after upgrading stripe-node to v23; the repo is on 20.0.0. The webhook signature verification at line 252 uses constructEvent. If the wrapper passes a custom tolerance of 0, v23 semantics would silently disable timestamp verification. The migration agent should check the tolerance argument when upgrading.
